description: DAY 0 master heroic v3 - corrections by founder May 2026: Ecuanutrition logo on belt, full Ecuador flag tassels (yellow+blue+red), refined face (no rostrum spike, smaller eyes, clean head silhouette), professional brand-new design
prompt:
ECUAMAN, official superhero mascot of ECUANUTRITION (Ecuadorian aquaculture brand). Anatomically accurate Penaeus vannamei (Pacific whiteleg shrimp) anthropomorphized as a confident Pixar-style underwater hero. Full body vertical heroic three-quarter pose, slightly tilted, facing camera, proud calm smile (NOT exaggerated), ready stance.

CRITICAL ANATOMY (must follow exactly):
- Single segmented vibrant orange (hex F39A2B) curved shrimp body with six clearly defined abdominal segments and a fan tail at the bottom (telson + uropods).
- NO human legs, NO boots — the lower body MUST be the curved shrimp tail.
- Muscular humanoid torso fused to the cephalothorax, six-pack abs visible through the orange shell.
- Two muscular humanoid arms with bare orange skin (NO gloves).
- HEAD/FACE — REFINED, NOT SPIKY: a clean smooth rounded shrimp head, soft short rostrum (NO long beak, NO sword-like nose, NO forehead horn, NO serrated spikes). The rostrum is a gentle short triangular tip flush with the head silhouette, max 1/8 of head length.
- EYES — MEDIUM size, expressive but NOT bug-eyed: two round friendly cartoon eyes with white sclera, dark pupil, and a subtle highlight. Eyes sit naturally on the head (very short eyestalks, not stalky giant orbs).
- ANTENNAE: TWO long thin elegant flexible antennae rising and curving softly outward, each ending in a TRI-COLOR FLAG TASSEL with three horizontal stripes in this exact order from top to bottom: YELLOW (#FFDD00) on top (thicker stripe), BLUE (#0033A0) in the middle, RED (#CE1126) at the bottom — the official Ecuador flag pattern. Both tassels visible and clearly tri-colored.

COSTUME (clean modern hero design):
- Royal blue (hex 0046AD) flowing cape billowing dramatically backwards, attached at the shoulders only.
- Sleek electric-blue (hex 1E88E5) belt around the waist.
- BELT BRANDING: the word ECUAMAN in bold white sans-serif capital letters across the front of the belt, AND directly above or beside it the official ECUANUTRITION wordmark/logo (lowercase 'ecuanutrition' in clean sans-serif white text with a small green leaf or stylized shrimp icon to its left, integrated into the belt design — both brands MUST be present and legible).
- EXACTLY ONE circular medallion centered on the belt: gold-rim circle (hex F2C744) with deep blue center containing a clean stylized white letter E formed by a curved shrimp silhouette (the Ecuanutrition emblem). This is the ONLY medallion in the entire image. Do NOT put a medallion on the chest.
- Right hand holds a tall glowing CYAN AQUA energy trident (hex 00D9FF) with three sharp prongs and a soft plasma halo.
- Left arm relaxed at the side or slightly flexed showing bicep.

BACKGROUND: deep Pacific Ocean dark blue gradient (hex 001A3D to 003A7D) with three diagonal sunlight god rays from upper-left, soft bioluminescent particles, faint silhouettes of mangrove roots in the lower distance.

STYLE: clean modern DreamWorks/Pixar 3D semi-realistic cinematic, professional brand mascot quality (NOT cartoonish, NOT chaotic), sharp focus, vibrant high-saturation colors, cinematic underwater lighting with cyan rim light on the silhouette, dramatic but elegant. Brand-new original design — NOT a revival of older versions.

REJECT in the output: long pointy beak, forehead spike, horn, multiple medallions, exaggerated rostrum teeth, bug eyes, gloves, boots, human legs, missing antennae, bicolor tassels, missing Ecuanutrition wordmark, watermarks, signatures, extra fingers.
